issues.where: the three pale rock arches spanning the pit and the boulders on the right wall
issues.what: the arches read as sculpted clay ribbons with repeated wavy strata and the boulders look like pasted blocky low-poly shapes rather than fractured rock
issues.fix: rebuild the arches and rim boulders with realistic geological fracture detail, varied materials, and scree or rubble where loose rocks rest on ledges

issues.where: the mist filling the left and lower pit
issues.what: the vapour reads as a flat, muddy grey-brown veil with almost no internal scattering from the bright upper-left sun
issues.fix: render volumetric vapour with directional light scattering, bright sunlit edges near the rim, and depth-dependent density variation

issues.where: right crop (x 83 to 100%, y 58 to 75%), foreground cliff and central boulder
issues.what: the central rock is a sharply faceted rectangular block and the surrounding cliff has blurry, stretched procedural brown-and-tan blotches with no fine rock grain
issues.fix: replace the low-poly block geometry with high-detail sculpted rock and apply high-resolution triplanar micro-detail textures without UV stretching

issues.where: top-left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%), overhanging red plant fronds
issues.what: the thin strands break into straight polygonal segments with angular kinks, harsh aliasing, and dotted dark ghosting along the edges
issues.fix: increase curve subdivision on the fronds, add organic thickness variation, and render with clean anti-aliasing and proper motion blur

issues.where: top-right crop (x 42 to 58%, y 25 to 42%), boulders on top of the middle arch
issues.what: the loose rocks sit on a soft, stretched procedural bridge surface with hard ungrounded edges and no dust, gravel, or contact integration
issues.fix: sharpen the bridge top texture with fine mineral detail and blend the boulders into the ledge with ambient occlusion, debris, and weathered contact

issues.where: left crop (x 42 to 58%, y 58 to 75%), upper-right rock arch seen through the mist
issues.what: a vertical mirrored symmetry seam is visible in the rock texture
issues.fix: remove mirrored UV mapping on the lower arch and use non-repeating procedural or varied scanned textures

issues.where: lower left, base and thick stems of the foreground red plant
issues.what: the stems and bulbous base look like smooth, untextured clay or plastic tubes intersecting the rocky ledge along a hard seam
issues.fix: add fibrous botanical surface detail and roughness variation to the stems and seat the root base into a crevice with grit and contact shadow

issues.where: top-left crop (x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42%), grey mist behind the red fronds
issues.what: faint tonal banding and contour lines appear across the smooth vapour gradient
issues.fix: render the mist at higher bit depth with fine film grain or dithering to eliminate banding
